hero.description: Customize your own personal digital working space designed around your needs and workflow. Create an environment that matches your style, whether you prefer minimal focus or immersive creativity. Work smarter, stay inspired, and build a space that truly feels like yours.
hero.readyText: Ready to create your own personal working space?

features.title: Your Ultimate Study Companion
features.subtitle: Every feature is thoughtfully designed to help you enter a state of deep focus and maintain it throughout your study session.

pomodoro.title: Pomodoro Timer
pomodoro.desc: Built-in focus timer with customizable Pomodoro sessions. Work in focused sprints and recover with purposeful breaks.

ambient.title: Ambient Soundscapes
ambient.desc: Choose from rain, café, forest, lo-fi beats and more. Curated audio environments that keep you in the zone.

backgrounds.title: Aesthetic Backgrounds
backgrounds.desc: Soft landscapes, cozy interiors, and minimalist scenes. Customize your visual environment to match your mood.

tasks.title: Task & Notes Board
tasks.desc: Keep your goals visible. Jot down tasks, ideas, and notes directly in your workspace without switching apps.

focus.title: Focus Mode
focus.desc: Distraction-free dark mode and minimal UI that disappears when you need pure concentration.

together.title: Study Together
together.desc: Join virtual study rooms with friends or strangers. Stay motivated with a sense of community presence.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Getting started takes less than 2 minutes. Here's your path to a better study session.

step1.title: Create Your Account
step1.desc: Sign up for free in seconds. No credit card required. Start personalizing your space right away.

step2.title: Set Up Your Space
step2.desc: Choose your background, pick your soundscape, and configure your Pomodoro timer to match your rhythm.

step3.title: Start Focusing
step3.desc: Enter deep work mode. Your personalized environment is ready — open your tasks, start the timer, and flow.

spacePreview.title: Set the Scene for Deep Focus
spacePreview.subtitle: Browse dozens of hand-curated aesthetic backgrounds — from misty forests to cozy café corners. Change your scenery, change your energy.

testimonials.title: What Our Community Says
testimonials.t1text: Aesthetic Study Space completely transformed my study sessions. The Pomodoro timer combined with lo-fi backgrounds kept me focused for hours without feeling burnt out.
testimonials.t2text: I use this for deep work blocks every morning. The ambient rain sounds and minimal UI let me get into flow state so much faster. Absolutely love it!
testimonials.t3text: Finally found a productivity tool that's actually beautiful to look at. The customizable backgrounds make such a difference. Highly recommend for remote workers.
testimonials.t4text: The virtual study rooms are my favorite feature. Knowing others are studying alongside me gives me the push I need to stay on track.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Should You
whyChooseUs.slide1desc: Structured 25-minute focus blocks with automatic break reminders to keep you sharp.
whyChooseUs.slide2desc: Layer café chatter, ocean waves, forest rain and lo-fi beats into your perfect audio mix.
whyChooseUs.slide3desc: Choose from handpicked scenes — misty mountains, cozy libraries, zen gardens and more.

cta.subtitle: Join thousands of students and creators who have already discovered the joy of studying in a beautiful, distraction-free environment. Start your free session today — no credit card needed.
